description: This file defines the ActivationCountPlacementDirector class, which implements a placement strategy for silos in Orleans based on activation counts. It manages local silo statistics, selects silos for activation considering load, and responds to silo statistics changes.

classes.name: ActivationCountPlacementDirector
classes.description: A placement director that assigns silos based on activation counts, balancing load by considering recent activity and silo overload status.

classes.name: CachedLocalStat
classes.description: A helper class that tracks activation count and silo statistics for a specific silo.

methods.name: ActivationCountPlacementDirector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the placement director with silo details, load publisher, and options.

methods.name: SelectSiloPowerOfK
methods.description: Selects a suitable silo based on load balancing logic, considering a subset of silos.

methods.name: OnAddActivation
methods.description: Handles the event of adding a new activation, determining the target silo.

methods.name: OnAddActivationInternal
methods.description: Internal method to determine the appropriate silo for activation based on context and hints.

methods.name: SiloStatisticsChangeNotification
methods.description: Updates local cache when silo statistics change.

methods.name: RemoveSilo
methods.description: Removes a silo from the local cache.
